title: Quadruple bus buffers with 3-state outputs

pins.name: 1G
pins.text: output enable; high puts 1Y in the high-impedance state

pins.name: 2G
pins.text: output enable; high puts 2Y in the high-impedance state

pins.name: 3G
pins.text: output enable; high puts 3Y in the high-impedance state

pins.name: 4G
pins.text: output enable; high puts 4Y in the high-impedance state

functions.text: 1Y follows 1A while 1G is low; high impedance while 1G is high.
2Y follows 2A while 2G is low; high impedance while 2G is high.
3Y follows 3A while 3G is low; high impedance while 3G is high.
4Y follows 4A while 4G is low; high impedance while 4G is high.

electrical.notes: SN74LS125A figures (page 6); off-state current +/-20 uA. SN74125: IOL 16 mA, IOH -5.2 mA (page 5).

unknown: The switching table does not name the input pins for each figure; A for tPLH/tPHL and G for the enable/disable times are taken from what those times mean.
notes: Timing is the SN74LS125A table (page 6). SN74125 (page 5, RL 400 ohm, CL 50 pF): tPLH 8/13, tPHL 12/18, tPZH 11/17, tPZL 16/25, tPHZ 5/8 (CL 5 pF), tPLZ 7/12 ns typ/max. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS125 too. The datasheet's 'LS125A is the A version; the card drawing says 74LS125.
